name: Shor order finding N=15 base 8 with 6 counting qubits
task_prompt: Implement the order-finding core of Shor's algorithm for N=15 and base a=8 using 6 counting qubits and a 4-qubit work register initialized to |1>. Build each controlled multiplication by a^(2^k) mod 15 as a reversible permutation UnitaryGate that maps x<15 to a^(2^k)*x mod 15 and leaves |15> fixed, apply inverse QFT, sample with a fixed seed, recover candidate periods with Fraction.limit_denominator(15), validate a^r mod 15=1, and print nontrivial factors obtained from gcd(a^(r/2)±1,15). Assert factors 3 and 5 are recovered from at least one high-probability outcome. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
